## Until next week [...] Enter Graphite Reviewer—your new AI-powered code review companion. Think of it as that always-available teammate who dives into your pull requests the second you open them, providing smart, targeted feedback in a fraction of the time. No more waiting in line for a review, and no more typos slipping through the cracks.

How does it work? As soon as a PR is opened, Graphite Reviewer jumps in, catching bugs, logical errors, and consistency issues before a human even touches it. The feedback is immediate, so authors can fix problems right away. Your reviewers can then focus on the big stuff—like design and functionality—rather than hunting for a stray semicolon.

I’ve used Product Hunt for years and always believed it was a place where real community support mattered. But our recent launch made me question whether the platform still reflects genuine engagement. [...] Based on 126 reviews

Review Product Hunt?

Reviewers mostly see Product Hunt as a strong place to discover new tools, watch tech trends, and get fast feedback from a lively community. Users repeatedly praise the comments, reviews, and launch-day exposure, while founders of ZapDigits, Stride, and PromptURLs say it reaches early adopters and brings real conversations. Still, some reviews point to weak support, confusing search and UX, app bugs, and concerns that launch results can feel opaque or unfair.
